document.abstract: Important events have occurred in the history of the Academy's progress since the last information conveyed to your distinguished Society. These events may be summarized under the following heading: 1. Installation of sound equipment. 2. College Cultural course. 3. Bestowal of Merit Awards. 4. Stanford-Muybridge Memorial.
